metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the verdict before church, the summons from Somerset House, four lines sent to Aldermanbury, and the work of Tuesday written on the tables.

yesterday: She refused another playhouse. The loaf was not measured.
Sir Edward wants the king whole at Canon Row, a gentleman's parlour. Twelve at table. Come by water at five. He did not name the guest.
Nine players and two boys. The three leaves are in the chest. The tide is right at five and wrong at midnight.
Bryan, going, said to bow to the chair by the fire, whoever is in it.
